classification: localOnly provider-relative Anvil observation; not public-chain finality or consensus proof

coverage.transferReceiptCoverage: complete within captured blocks for this RPC

limitations: The RPC provider supplies both historical state reads and eth_getLogs; this is provider-relative evidence.
Intermediate same-block states are unsupported and cause rejection rather than inferred ordering.
Only the pinned local token implementation is covered; fee-on-transfer, rebasing and arbitrary token behavior are excluded.
This is not a public-chain finality or consensus proof.

localChainIdentity.scope: chain lineage fingerprint; does not uniquely identify an RPC provider or Anvil process

token.behaviorScope: Pinned local token runtime only; no fee-on-transfer, rebasing, native-value, or arbitrary-token claim.
